texts.en: The Centa-City Leading Index stood at 158.61 for 2026-11-02 – 2026-11-08, down from 159.11 in the previous weekly reading. The Rating and Valuation Department Private Domestic Price Index was 320.8 in 2026-09, up from 320.2 in 2026-08. The Midland Realty Property Price Index was 148.1 on 2026-11-09, down from 148.4 on 2026-11-02. The indices use different base periods, so the levels are not directly comparable. The stated bases are July 1997 = 100 for the first index, 1999 = 100 for the second, and published index points for the third; the figures above describe movements within each series only.
texts.zh-Hant: 這三個指數基期不同，點數不能直接比較。最新水平及較上一期變化如下：中原城市領先指數最新158.61點，較上一期跌0.50點；差餉物業估價署私人住宅售價指數最新320.8點，升0.6點；美聯物業樓價指數最新148.1點，跌0.3點。
